assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A country- and category-scoped App Store market-analysis workflow covering chart movement, search trends, featured placements, releases, dynamics, and next-week watch items.
assessments.rationale: The skill structures meeting documentation and action items, rather than collecting or synthesizing App Store market evidence.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An App Store market-briefing workflow for the requested country and category, including the specified commercial signals and watch items.
assessments.rationale: This is a bulk-expression pathway-analysis workflow and does not address mobile-app market briefing.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Integrated inputs and reporting for rising search terms, featured placements, recent releases, category dynamics, and three next-week watch items.
assessments.rationale: It provides country- and category-aware chart-movement analysis, but its stated scope omits several required market signals for the combined weekly briefing.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A mobile-app market-analysis workflow that gathers the requested market evidence and produces a weekly briefing.
assessments.rationale: The skill facilitates software sprint retrospectives rather than analyzing App Store market activity.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An App Store market-briefing workflow for country/category trends, including charts, keywords, featuring, releases, and watch items.
assessments.rationale: This is an AWS data-lake asset resolver and does not provide mobile-app market analysis.

It explicitly combines chart movements, trending keywords, featured apps, new releases, and category dynamics into a country/category App Store market overview with consequential headlines and forward-looking recommendations.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A country/category App Store market-analysis workflow that assembles the requested external market signals and watch items.
assessments.rationale: The skill is a personal productivity weekly-review procedure, not a mobile-app market briefing.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A broad country/category market briefing that also covers featured placements, new releases, category dynamics, and three next-week watch items beyond tracked competitors.
assessments.rationale: It supports recurring competitor monitoring with chart and keyword signals, but its competitor-specific scope lacks the complete market-wide evidence set requested.
